title: State and output summary after one step
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $x$ be a Boolean input word, and let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on $x$. The state and output summary after one step is obtained by applying the summary update rule to the current state and output summary of $c$ together with the symbols read by the input and work-tape heads in $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine over Boolean symbols
